summary: Keep non-exported namespace declarations local to IIFE.

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

semantics.capture: exported functions may close over local

tests.name: not property
tests.input: namespace N { const hidden=2; export const x=1 }; console.log((N as any).hidden);

tests.name: closure
tests.input: namespace N { const hidden=2; export function f(){return hidden} }; console.log(N.f());
